games.name: Dinosaur World Mobile
games.desc:
With over 70 + Mesozoic species from land, sea and air, Dinosaur World Mobile allows you to research bigger and stronger dinosaurs in order to increase your chances of survival as you explore the world and interact with others.

The Ecosystem game mode allows you to experience an ecosystem of dinosaurs in their respective habitats, with a food chain consisting of a range of carnivores, herbivores and omnivores.

- Hunt for food and manage your hunger, thirst and sleep
- Research dinosaurs to unlock stronger ones
- Customise your appearance
- Make friends or fight your enemies
 
This game has been optimised for mobile, tablet, and computer devices.

games.name: 1984 Utopia
games.desc:
Experience a blend of DarkRP and “Become Leader" genres, with 13 roles to play!

V2: WHAT’S NEW?
A total game renovation with a ton of NEW features:
- BASE-BUILDING
- MASSIVE OPTIMISATION, greatly improved FPS
- Innovative “interactable” props system
- New Vehicle System 
- New Crafting System
- https://devforum.roblox.com/t/1984-game-overhaul-sep-25-update/4893184

PC Controls:
B - Build Mode
C - Toggle Combat
G - Open Inventory
H - Drop Item
N - Emotes
T - Open Overview

GAMEPLAY:
- As a Wastelander, enjoy a “peaceful” life in the city… or go out in the hot waste, some rebuild society there.
- Build a shop, a hospital, start your own bank, a restaurant, a farm, even a fort!

- As the Leader, run the nation; enact policies, maintain authority, appoint officials - while dealing with unhappy rebels!
